parole.testo: From the same root as eraldi, eri, ultimately from Proto-Indo-Iranian *er-.

parole.significato: wake (a party held in the honour of the dead, after a funeral)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *peijeh, probably from Proto-Indo-Iranian *paiyas, or alternatively from Proto-Germanic *faigijaz. Compare Old Norse feigr (“near death”) and Sanskrit वाजपेय (vāja-péya, “ritual drink when sacrificing, potion of strength”). Cognate with Finnish peijaiset, peijaat, and Karelian peij
